description: Translate text between 21 languages: en, de, fr, es, it, pt, nl, pl, sv, cs, el, ru, uk, tr, ar, hi, id, vi, zh, ja, ko. Runs on our own server (Argos Translate), so the text is not sent to a third party. Max 1000 characters per call. source_lang defaults to auto-detect; confidence is the detection confidence. Pairs without a direct model are translated via English. Price: $0.009 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"text":"Hello, how are you?","target_lang":"de"}.

source_lang.description: Source language code. Default: 'auto' (auto-detect). Use ISO 639-1 codes.

text.description: Text to translate (max 1000 characters per call; longer text is truncated)
